scope.summary: Implement internal holes/cutouts in PanelSpec (second-pass MD parity CG-01, MD 'Convert to Hole'): add an InternalShape kind Hole (closed internal contour excluded from tessellation) to the GarmentSpec panel model per Section 13.6/13.14, so vents, keyholes, and cloth eyelet holes are authorable; update PANEL_CLOSED and MESH_MANIFOLD validation to accept hole-bounded topology.
acceptance_criteria: PanelSpec supports internal Hole contours (closed polyline/Bezier per EdgeShape rules); schema hsk.tailor.garment_spec@1 extended additively with schemars derivation intact.

Tessellation (MT-127 pipeline) excludes hole interiors and produces manifold-with-boundary triangle output; hole boundary vertices carry stable ids for trims (lacing eyelets MT-176/177 can anchor to hole rims).

PANEL_CLOSED and MESH_MANIFOLD validation descriptors updated: a panel with holes passes when outline and every hole contour are closed and non-intersecting; overlapping/outline-crossing holes fail with a typed finding.
edit_garment merge patches can add/move/delete holes; CRDT merge treats hole contours like internal lines (LWW per vertex, tombstone delete).
scope.risk_if_missed: Without cloth holes, vents/keyholes/eyelet-anchored lacing garments cannot be authored and the MD workflow gap forces geometry hacks; lacing (MT-177) has no cloth-side anchor rims.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
